description: This file defines a custom exception class OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException used in the Orleans Runtime membership service to indicate failure in cluster connectivity checks.

classes.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating failure to verify cluster connectivity. It inherits from OrleansException and provides multiple constructors for different use cases.

methods.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException()
methods.description: Default constructor with a preset error message indicating failed connectivity.

methods.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor allowing custom message and inner exception for detailed error reporting.

methods.name: OrleansClusterConnectivityCheckFailedException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Serialization constructor marked as obsolete, used during deserialization.
